about: Ransom's Rest's town buildings re-finished with no new draw (Docs/Work/2026-11-04-Towns/PLAN.md 4.2 item 1): each building's roof tint (on the house trim's shake strip E), siding tint (on its weathered siding strip A; whitewash is a lerp to cream) and porch (the H1 teal and H2 oxide-red trim boards swapped or not), read by M_World's TrimRecolor (on MI_HouseTrim) from the building's custom primitive data, set by Tools/Unreal/build_area_town_looks.py after the build. tints: the plan's (linear multipliers; wash: how far the siding goes to cream 0xe6dac2 after the tint). buildings: by placement id (the actor's label); roof is a tint name, or roofKit names a roof that isn't the shake strip (Home_J's planks, Home_E's sod: no tint, and it differs from every tinted roof); lived/shut is the story's (the lived ones cared for: whitewash, honey shakes; the shut ones tarred and dark). sides: buildings in order along a street side: consecutive ones differ in roof AND siding AND porch; facing: across Main Street (its two sides) any pair whose placements stand within facingReach cm along the street faces, and differs in 2 of the 3. The script refuses a table that breaks either rule and prints the pairs.
